jei.cryonite.acquisition.cryonite_ore: Overworld: Deepslate and Tuff (Y -64 to 0), more common in the Deep Dark and frozen biomes. Freezes you while in the inventory!
jei.cryonite.acquisition.cryonite_templa: Structure: Ancient City, 25% chance per chest. Duplicated on the crafting table with 7 Netherite Ingots and Deepslate.
jei.cryonite.acquisition.infernite_ore: Nether: Basalt Deltas (Y 8 to 96), wrapped in magma and blackstone. Burns the player and melts wood and stone in the inventory unless ice or snowballs are carried!
jei.cryonite.acquisition.infernite_templ: Structure: treasure rooms of Piglin Bastions (low chance: 7.5% per chest). Duplicated with 7 Cryonite Ingots and Basalt.
jei.cryonite.acquisition.silk_touch: The ore itself drops with Silk Touch
jei.cryonite.acquisition.void_ore: The End: outer islands, the lowest layer above the void (Y = 0..12). DANGER: breaking it drags you down into the void and blinds you for 3 seconds!
jei.cryonite.acquisition.void_template: Structure: End City treasure chests, End Ships included (17.5% chance per chest). Duplicated with 7 Infernite Ingots and Dragon's Breath.
jei.cryonite.info.aether_ingot:
Inactive Aether smelted in the Primordial Smelter on a Block of Infernite.

Aether weapons, tools and armor are crafted on the crafting table in the usual shapes (ingots and sticks), no template needed.
jei.cryonite.info.aether_nugget: One ninth of an Aether Ingot. Craft 9 nuggets into an ingot on the crafting table (and back).
jei.cryonite.info.cooled_infernite_blank:
A Molten Infernite Shard cooled in a Powder Snow Cauldron, on Blue Ice or with Cryonite Crystal Dust.

Primordial Smelter: the blank + a Block of Gold and a Ghast Tear (catalysts), fuel: Blaze Powder, Blaze Rod or Lava Bucket. The result is an Infernite Ingot.
jei.cryonite.info.cryonite_crystal_dust:
Smelted from Raw Cryonite in the Primordial Smelter (fuel: Blaze Rod or Magma Block).

Dust + Netherite Scrap or an Echo Shard = Cryonite Ingot, either on the crafting table or in the Smelter (scrap or shard in a catalyst slot).

On the crafting table the dust also cools a Molten Infernite Shard.
jei.cryonite.info.cryonite_ingot:
Cryonite Crystal Dust + Netherite Scrap or an Echo Shard (crafting table or Primordial Smelter).

Smithing table: Cryonite Upgrade template + a Netherite item + the ingot. 7 ingots duplicate the Infernite Upgrade template. Also needed for Inactive Aether.
jei.cryonite.info.cryonite_nugget: One ninth of a Cryonite Ingot. Craft 9 nuggets into an ingot on the crafting table (and back).
jei.cryonite.info.inactive_aether:
Crafting table: Netherite Ingot + Cryonite Ingot + Infernite Ingot + Void Ingot.

Smelt it in the Primordial Smelter with a Block of Infernite as fuel to get an Aether Ingot.
jei.cryonite.info.infernite_block:
9 Infernite Ingots on the crafting table (and back).

The only fuel of the Primordial Smelter that is hot enough to awaken Inactive Aether.
jei.cryonite.info.infernite_ingot:
Smelted from a Cooled Infernite Blank in the Primordial Smelter (Block of Gold + Ghast Tear).

Smithing table: Infernite Upgrade template + a Cryonite item + the ingot. 9 ingots make a Block of Infernite. Also needed for the Molten Void Blank, Inactive Aether and to duplicate the Void Upgrade template.
jei.cryonite.info.infernite_nugget: One ninth of an Infernite Ingot. Craft 9 nuggets into an ingot on the crafting table (and back).
jei.cryonite.info.kinetic_energy_convert:
Needs the Create mod. Crafting: Cryonite, Infernite, Void and Aether Ingots in the corners, a Block of Redstone on top, an Electron Tube, a Brass Casing and a Shaft in the middle row, a Precision Mechanism at the bottom.

Turns Forge Energy into rotation. The shaft leaves through the front; the other five sides accept up to 1,000,000 FE/t from the cables of any mod into a buffer of 10,000,000 FE.

Right-click opens the control panel: speed from 0 to 8048 RPM, direction and a power switch.
- Stress capacity: 1024 SU per RPM (8,241,152 SU at 8048 RPM)
- Consumption: 4 FE/t per RPM (32,192 FE/t at 8048 RPM)
Without energy the generator stops.

With this block installed Create's speed limit (maxRotationSpeed) is raised from 256 to 8048 RPM.
jei.cryonite.info.molten_infernite_shard:
Third way: combine the shard with Cryonite Crystal Dust on the crafting table.

Snowballs, Ice, Packed Ice or Blue Ice in the inventory stop the shard from burning you and your items.
jei.cryonite.info.molten_void_blank: Made of 4 Stabilized Void Clusters, 4 Infernite Ingots and a Shulker Shell (crafting table or Primordial Smelter).
jei.cryonite.info.molten_void_blank.craf: Without obsidian: combine the blank with Blue Ice on the crafting table.
jei.cryonite.info.primordial_smelter:
Crafting: 4 Obsidian, 2 Blaze Rods, 2 Netherite Scrap and a Blast Furnace.

Slots: main ingredient, up to two catalysts, fuel and result. Catalyst slots a recipe does not use must stay empty. Every recipe burns its own fuel, ordinary fuel does not work:
- Raw Cryonite, Cryonite dust: Blaze Rod or Magma Block
- Cooled Infernite Blank: Blaze Powder, Blaze Rod or Lava Bucket
- Stabilized Void Clusters: Blaze Rod or Lava Bucket
- Inactive Aether: Block of Infernite
jei.cryonite.info.raw_cryonite:
Raw Cryonite radiates cold: while you carry it you are slowed and slowly freeze. Leather or Cryonite armor and the Nether keep you warm.

Smelt it in the Primordial Smelter (fuel: Blaze Rod or Magma Block) into Cryonite Crystal Dust.
jei.cryonite.info.stabilized_void_cluste:
An Unstable Void Shard stabilized in a cloud of Dragon's Breath or on the crafting table.

4 clusters + 4 Infernite Ingots + a Shulker Shell = Molten Void Blank, either on the crafting table or in the Primordial Smelter (fuel: Blaze Rod or Lava Bucket).
jei.cryonite.info.unstable_void_shard: Without a dragon: 8 shards around a bottle of Dragon's Breath on the crafting table give 8 Stabilized Void Clusters.
jei.cryonite.info.void_ingot:
A Molten Void Blank quenched on Crying Obsidian or with Blue Ice.

Smithing table: Void Upgrade template + an Infernite item + the ingot. Also needed for Inactive Aether.
jei.cryonite.info.void_nugget: One ninth of a Void Ingot. Craft 9 nuggets into an ingot on the crafting table (and back).
jei.cryonite.world_interaction.blue_ice: Right-click a block of Blue Ice with the molten shard (the ice thaws into regular Ice). One block quenches up to 16 shards.
jei.cryonite.world_interaction.crying_ob: Drop the blank (Q) onto a block of Crying Obsidian and wait 5 seconds.
jei.cryonite.world_interaction.dragon_br: Drop the shards (Q) straight into a cloud of the Ender Dragon's breath during the fight.
jei.cryonite.world_interaction.powder_sn: Right-click a Powder Snow Cauldron with the molten shard. One layer of snow quenches up to 16 shards.
